To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the deposition rate of HA coating on hollow glass microsphere was influenced by SBF concentration, activation of HGM and solid/liquid ratio.

(1) the HA coated HGM with the thickness of approximately 2 μm can be prepared by a biomimetic method, and the coating thickness is almost independent of the immersion time in 1.50SBF with the solid/ liquid ratio of 1/150; (2) the SBF concentration, the solid/liquid weight ratio and the activation of HGM have a significant influence on the deposition rate of HA coating on the microspheres.
a dense and uniform poorly crystalline HA coating with the average thickness of about 1.5 μm can be deposited on the surface of HGM by biomimetic method.

the preparation of HA coated HGM and the factors influencing HA coating.
the preparation of HA coating on hollow glass microsphere by biomimetic method and the influence of SBF concentration and immersion time on HA deposition.
the factors influencing the deposition of HA coating on the HGM and the characteristics of the coating.
